tasks.subject: Task 1: Server protos, network code, `otter-admin network code`
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The wire format has `listed`, `server_version` and the two request messages; Go can compute the network code

**Verify:** `cd otter-server-m95 && go test -p 4 ./internal/netcode/ ./cmd/otter-admin/ -run 'Code|NetworkCode'` → `ok` twice

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m95/proto/otter/v1/records.proto", "otter-server-m95/internal/netcode/netcode.go", "otter-server-m95/cmd/otter-admin/main.go"], "verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server-m95 && go test -p 4 ./internal/netcode/ ./cmd/otter-admin/ -run 'Code|NetworkCode'` → `ok` twice", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`DirectoryEntry.listed = 12`, `LoginResponse.server_version = 4`, `DirectoryGetRequest{repeated bytes user_ids = 1}`, `DirectoryLookupRequest{string username = 1}` exist and `make gen` is clean (buf lint passes).", "`netcode.Code` matches all three vectors.", "`otter-admin --dir D network code` prints `network code: ddddd ddddd ddddd` without asking for a passphrase."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Server visible set (store relations, ancestry closure)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `Service.VisibleDirectory(ctx, user)` returns exactly the D135 set; `Service.Directory` stays complete.

**Verify:** `go test -p 4 ./internal/store/ ./internal/service/ -run 'Visib|Relations'` → `ok` twice

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m95/internal/store/visibility.go", "otter-server-m95/internal/service/visibility.go"], "verifyCommand": "`go test -p 4 ./internal/store/ ./internal/service/ -run 'Visib|Relations'` → `ok` twice", "acceptanceCriteria": ["A invites B, B invites C, D is network-invited and unlisted, E is listed: A sees {A, B, E}; B sees {A, B, C, E}; C sees {B, C, E} **plus A as ancestry** (A is B's inviter); D sees {D, E}.", "Every answer contains all REVOCATION, INVITE_RIGHTS and REKEY records, as `Directory` does.", "A re-keyed account keeps its relations: if B re-keys to B2, A sees B2 (and the revoked B).", "An unlisted member never appears for an unrelated caller unless as ancestry of someone the caller may see.", "`Directory(ctx)` output is unchanged (admin list)."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Server `DirectoryGet` and `LookupUsername`
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fetch entries by id and one exact username, with ancestry, under the lookup limit.

**Verify:** `go test -p 4 ./internal/service/ -run 'DirectoryGet|Lookup'` → `ok`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m95/internal/service/visibility.go", "otter-server-m95/internal/service/visibility_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "`go test -p 4 ./internal/service/ -run 'DirectoryGet|Lookup'` → `ok`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`DirectoryGet` with > 256 ids → `ErrInvalid`; with known ids → their entries plus ancestry; unknown ids are skipped.", "`LookupUsername(\"@Boris\")` finds `boris` (case, `@`, spaces ignored); `name#tag` resolves through `ResolveUsername`; unknown or revoked → `ErrNotFound`.", "The 31st lookup within an hour → `ErrQuota`, failed lookups count; the day limit is 200."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Server gateway methods and the version in the login answer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `directory.sync`/`directory.list` filtered, `directory.get`, `directory.lookup` callable, `LoginResponse.server_version` set.

**Verify:** `go test -p 4 ./internal/gateway/ -run 'Privacy|LoginVersion'` → `ok`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m95/internal/gateway/methods.go", "otter-server-m95/internal/gateway/privacy_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "`go test -p 4 ./internal/gateway/ -run 'Privacy|LoginVersion'` → `ok`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Over the wire, `directory.sync` and `directory.list` return the same filtered set; `admin.users` still returns all.", "`directory.lookup` for an unknown name → `STATUS_NOT_FOUND`; the 31st → `STATUS_QUOTA`.", "`LoginResponse.server_version` equals the binary's version; `hello` carries no version.", "`directory.lookup` is in the per-user write bucket (`userWrites`) as a second brake."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: App protos, `NodeApi` calls and old-node fallback, fake node
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The app can call `directory.list/get/lookup`, falls back on an old node, and tests can serve all of it.

**Verify:** `./gradlew :core:network:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*DirectoryFallback*' :core:data:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*DirectorySync*'` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-android-m95/core/proto/src/main/proto/otter/v1/*.proto", "otter-android-m95/core/network/src/main/kotlin/app/ottermsg/core/network/NodeApi.kt", "otter-android-m95/core/data/src/test/kotlin/app/ottermsg/core/data/FakeNode.kt", "otter-android-m95/core/network/src/test/kotlin/app/ottermsg/core/network/DirectoryFallbackTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "`./gradlew :core:network:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*DirectoryFallback*' :core:data:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*DirectorySync*'` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`NodeApi` has `directoryList()`, `directoryGet(ids)`, `directoryLookup(username)` with defaults that fall back to `directory()` (list, get) or throw `OldNodeException` (lookup).", "`RemoteNodeApi.directoryList()` on a node that answers `STATUS_INVALID \"unknown method …\"` calls `directory.sync` instead, and remembers that for the session.", "`directoryLookup` maps `STATUS_NOT_FOUND` → `null`, `STATUS_QUOTA` → `LookupLimitException`.", "`FakeNode` serves the three methods with the server's rules (visible set = own + listed + direct relation + ancestry)."]}
```

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-android-m95/core/database/src/main/kotlin/app/ottermsg/core/database/entity/ContactEntity.kt", "otter-android-m95/core/data/src/main/kotlin/app/ottermsg/core/data/directory/DirectorySync.kt", "otter-android-m95/feature/chats/.../NewChatViewModel.kt", "otter-android-m95/core/data/src/test/kotlin/app/ottermsg/core/data/CatalogTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "`./gradlew :core:database:testDebugUnitTest :core:data:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*Catalog*' --tests '*DirectorySync*' --tests '*Mailbox*'` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`contacts` has `listed` and `related` (default 0); `ContactDao.observeCatalog()` returns non-revoked contacts that are listed, related, a 1:1 peer (`conversations.peer_user_id`) or a group member (`group_members.user_id`).", "**Hostile node:** an entry served by the node whose signed `listed` is false and that has no relation stays out of the catalog (it is stored, for chain checks).", "Ancestry entries (inviter of my inviter) are stored but not in the catalog.", "A message from a sender not in the store triggers `directoryGet([sender])`, not a full sync.", "`DirectorySync.sync` calls `directoryList()` then `directoryGet(peers ∪ group members)`.", "The inviter placeholder from the invite link (entryVersion 0) is `related = true`."]}
```
